text: The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit’s Blackness and Belonging training session is a 2 hour training that is designed to introduce participants to the primary concepts, ideas, histories, contexts, and language that are central to understanding and addressing Anti-Black racism at the systemic and institutional levels. This training will use language, statistics, Canadian history, and selected case studies, to focus on understanding the definition of Anti-Black Racism and identifying the ways Anti-Black racism is shaping our experience of what it means to be a Toronto resident. Learners will examine the social contexts, implications and impacts of identifying and navigating Anti-Black racism.
